policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.

claims.label: observed
claims.text: Division's top scorers Southern New Hampshire suffer first defeat Southern New Hampshire went to Adelphi without a defeat all season and came away with their first. The goals have not dried up over the season: no other programme in the division has scored as many as they have.
claims.note: held against every other programme; the nearest is charleston at 43
